affected_system: public participation, multilingual communication, consultation, and feedback closure
alternatives: activate a bounded reserve from forecast risk bands for public participation and risk-communication demand
use rolling forecasts and conservative capacity triggers for public participation and risk-communication demand
pair issue-, channel-, language-, and event-conditioned engagement forecasting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Invitation, exposure, participation, contribution, response, decision, and trust remain distinct.
Participation records preserve consent, privacy, language, accessibility, and channel provenance.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: continue ordinary capacity planning for public participation and risk-communication demand.

constraints.description: The public participation and risk communication forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: public engagement director and risk communications lead
decision_question: What issue, language, channel, time, and accessibility demand should engagement operations prepare for?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The public participation and risk communication forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for public participation and risk-communication demand passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: issue-, channel-, language-, and event-conditioned engagement forecasting
independence_key.primary_outcome: affected participation demand above usable channel capacity

intended_claim: A versioned forecast design for comparing declared alternatives affecting public participation and risk-communication demand, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: affected participation demand above usable channel capacity
distributional gap in affected participation demand above usable channel capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call forecast engagement actual participation, agreement, trust, or public sentiment.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for public participation and risk-communication demand passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.

title: Forecast participation and communication demand
transportability_risks: Trust, language, civic institutions, digital access, deliberation norms, and risk salience differ.
Participants are not automatically representative of affected populations.
